manual_notes: The shared groceries factory exists and supplies memoized data, computed done/pending lists and mutations. However, the selected scope requires the shared factory to create separate data/UI contexts and accept storage, exposing useGroceriesUIContext. The pinned factory creates only one data context and accepts query/mutation/subscription adapters; UI/storage behavior remains in the web wrapper. Strict full scope is therefore unconfirmed.
